IC1: - Registered nurses, working in intensive care units (ICU) [OR] or department of emergency (ED).
IC2: - The frequency of headaches more than three times per month.
IC3: - The type of headache is migraine [OR] or frequent episodic tension-type headache, which is defined by the Headache Classification Committee of the International Headache Society.
